title: Edge LLM on FPGAs: four Kria KV260 boards decoding one Llama-3.2-1B stream
description: An int4 weight-streaming matrix-vector engine for the AMD Kria KV260 (Vitis HLS), a bit-exact contract for ggml Q4_0 weights and Q8_0 activations, and a tensor-parallel runtime that decodes one Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct stream across four boards behind an OpenAI-compatible API. Measured numbers are reported in docs/buildlog with their raw logs under docs/buildlog/evidence.
